title: When Operating Profit Changes Meaning
subtitle: Ind AS 118 / IFRS 18 and the CFO who must restyle the P&L before 1 April 2027 — without inventing a Gazette
description: HBS-style teaching case on IFRS 18 (effective 1 January 2027) and NFRA’s 22 December 2025 recommendation that Ind AS 118 apply from 1 April 2027 for most Indian companies. A labelled composite CFO must choose among waiting for the MCA Gazette, running a shadow P&L, early application if notified, or retiring a homemade ‘core operating EBITDA’ before it becomes an MPM.
